replacement_comparisons.assessment: Both expand the configured probe workspace before mkdir and session creation, addressing overlapping home-relative/relative-path behavior. Earlier PR2644 expands the root before joining, adds a workspace_root override and diagnostic/error mapping; later merged PR2685 expands the joined path with a one-line production change. These are overlapping fixes, not identical patches or complete behavioral equivalence.

Both reinstall missing GitHub support around workspace refresh/reconstruction. Earlier PR2669 repairs the guard during ready-workspace finalization and staged reconstruction, including a remote repair function. Later PR2701 reinstalls the complete support set after reconstruction/recreation and adds missing-piece checks, quota-directory provisioning, dispatch and per-turn guards, and queue restoration on refused turns. The problem overlaps but the later acceptance surface is broader and differently placed; treating it as identical repeated work overstates the evidence.
